name: Gen Z Maximalism
summary: Gen Z Maximalism refers to the colourful, cluttered aesthetic popularized by Gen-Z via social media/mediums like TikTok and Instagram.
description: Gen Z Maximalism refers to the colourful, cluttered aesthetic popularized by Gen-Z via social media/mediums like TikTok and Instagram. It's unknown who originally coined the term "Gen-Z Maximalism", but it likely is referencing the contrast between the minimalist aesthetic commonly enjoyed by Millennials.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Clutter, maximalism, use of various highly saturated colors

visualDNA.colour: All of them, but highly saturated
